requirements.verifier_assertion: Renderer clear color / scene background is black 0x000000 (initial scene framing for the rubric scene probes).
PerspectiveCamera is at position (0, 0, 3) looking at origin; window.__3D_STATE__.cameraZ reflects the camera z position (rubric state probe).
Affordance A1 PlaneGeometry: a 4x4 / 128x128-segment plane tilted -0.3 rad on X, present as window.__3D_STATE__.planeExists === true.
Affordance A2 SphereGeometry: radius 0.4, 64 segments at (0, 0.8, 0), present as window.__3D_STATE__.sphereExists === true.
Ambient light (intensity 0.3) plus one DirectionalLight at (2, 3, 2) with intensity 1.0 (scene correctness context for rubric probes).
OrbitControls enabled for camera interaction (rubric scene requires interactive camera).
window.__3D_STATE__.fresnelUniformsBound === true: the ShaderMaterial defines uTime, uSpeed, uFilmThickness, uIntensity uniforms.
Uniform defaults/ranges: uSpeed default 0.5; uFilmThickness range 0.2 to 3.0; uIntensity range 0.0 to 2.0 (drives S3/S4/S5 changed-state assertions).
Fresnel-indexed palette cycles magenta -> blue -> cyan -> green -> yellow -> red (shader semantic).
must_include: magenta -> blue -> cyan -> green -> yellow -> red

requirements.verifier_assertion: Affordance A3 ThicknessSlider id='thicknessSlider' (min=0.2, max=3.0, step=0.1, default=1.0) updates uFilmThickness -> state S3.
Affordance A4 SpeedSlider id='speedSlider' (min=0.0, max=2.0, step=0.1, default=0.5) updates uSpeed -> state S4.
Affordance A5 IntensitySlider id='intensitySlider' (min=0.0, max=2.0, step=0.1, default=1.0) updates uIntensity -> state S5.
Affordance A6 PauseButton id='pauseBtn' toggles paused (S1/S2); text shows 'Pause' or 'Resume'; when paused uTime stops incrementing.
Affordance A7 ResetButton id='resetBtn' labeled 'Reset' resets all uniforms to defaults and resumes animation (state S9 ResetToDefaults).
Keyboard key 'T' toggles wireframe mode on both meshes -> states S6 WireframeOn / S7 WireframeOff (window.__3D_STATE__.wireframe).
Affordances A8-A11 value spans #timeDisplay/#thicknessDisplay/#speedDisplay/#intensityDisplay; time display rounded to 1 decimal.
Affordance A12 ControlPanel id='controlPanel' holds all controls, top-left.
window.__3D_STATE__.shaderCompiled === true once the ShaderMaterial compiles (rubric transition L0/L2 checks).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame and updates uTime by delta * speed each frame when not paused (drives time-advance transitions).
must_include: delta * speed each frame when not paused

requirements.verifier_assertion: Exact grader DOM selectors must be used verbatim: #thicknessSlider, #speedSlider, #intensitySlider, #pauseBtn, #resetBtn, #timeDisplay.
Deliverable is a single self-contained index.html at the workspace root; any other filename scores zero.
